about: Generalisation benchmark G42 (train split), in dev.json format. Tier 4 = a real product, here a single printed adapter whose ends are sized from the bought-in things it joins (a 16 mm inner diameter hose and a 25 mm outside diameter pipe, both parametric stand-ins from the parts catalogue): a barbed spigot, a stepped transition, a socket with a pipe stop, a through bore and a print orientation. L1 ids match benchmarks/generalize/designs/G42/requirements.md, which holds the L2/L3 tree, the reference models, the assumptions, the fixed decisions and the traceability. Numbers that are not in the owner's words (hose and pipe wall, rib profile, transition angle, wall range) come from requirements.md section 3. Never put any of these numbers in agent logic: they belong in the request text and in the part.json catalogue.

methods.inspection: read from the design or mesh (counts, sizes, positions, relations)
methods.analysis: computed by Python (profile slices, interference and clearance against reference models, overhang scan, hand calculations)
methods.demonstration: a stand-in object is placed in the design (fits, rests, does not slide)
methods.test: a probe is applied (push the pipe into the socket, push the hose over the spigot)

requests.title: 16 mm hose to 25 mm pipe adapter
requests.request: A hose adapter that joins a hose of 16 mm inner diameter to a pipe of 25 mm outside diameter. The hose end is a barbed spigot with a 16 mm body and three ribs 0.8 mm tall. The pipe end is a socket for the 25 mm pipe, with the bore 0.15 mm bigger than the pipe (0.15 mm loose), 20 mm deep, ending in a stop shoulder for the pipe. The wall is 2 mm throughout. The adapter has a through bore for the flow, an overall length of 60 mm, and a transition between the two sizes that is no steeper than 45 degrees. It must print upright (axis vertical) on an FDM printer in PLA without supports.
requests.request_verbatim: A hose adapter from a 16 mm inner diameter hose onto a 25 mm OD pipe: a barbed 16 mm end with three ribs 0.8 mm tall, a 2 mm wall, and a socket for the 25 mm pipe 0.15 mm loose, 20 mm deep. Overall length 60 mm and it must print upright without supports.
requests.request_notes: Added to the brief, all from requirements.md section 3: the spigot body is 16.0 mm and the ribs stand 0.8 above it (A1, F1); '0.15 mm loose' is a diametral clearance, bore 25.15 (A2, F2); pipe stop shoulder at the bottom of the socket (F3); the 45 degree limit on the transition follows from printing upright (A5); spigot end down when printing (F5).

l1.text: The hose end shall be a spigot with a 16.0 mm body and exactly three barb ribs, each 0.8 mm tall, with retention flanks no steeper than 45 degrees from the axis, with the retention flank 30 to 45 degrees and the lead-in flank 10 to 30 degrees from the axis, the crests at least 5.0 mm apart, the first crest at least 3.0 mm from the tip and the last at least 4.0 mm before the end of the straight part, so a 16 mm hose pushes on and does not pull off.

The straight part of the spigot shall be at least 25 mm long and the profile shall widen behind it, so a hose pushed on has a length to grip and a stop: the straight part ends between 25.0 and 33.0 mm from the tip, and the outside radius reaches 11.0 mm (half of a 22 mm hose outside diameter) within 5.0 mm after it.

The pipe end shall be a socket 20.0 mm deep with a bore 0.15 mm bigger than the 25 mm pipe (25.15 mm), ending in a flat shoulder that stops the pipe, so the pipe slides in and seats: the bore is constant over the whole depth with no step or rib, the shoulder is square to the axis within 1.0 degree, at least 3.0 mm wide radially and backed by at least 2.0 mm of solid, and the 25 mm pipe seats with its end face within 0.10 mm of the shoulder.
The wall of the spigot and of the socket shall be 2.0 to 2.4 mm thick, and no wall anywhere shall be thinner than 2.0 mm.

The adapter shall be 60.0 mm long with a through bore along its whole length, every section coaxial with the same axis, and no restriction in the bore below 11.2 mm, every section within 0.10 mm of the axis.

The outside shall change from the 16 mm spigot to the socket in one smooth transition no steeper than 45 degrees from the axis, with no step other than the barb ribs, between 15 and 45 degrees from the axis and never narrowing, ending at the socket's outside diameter.

The adapter shall print upright with its axis vertical and the spigot end on the bed, with no overhang steeper than 45 degrees from vertical, a bed contact of at least 80 mm2 and a height of at most four times the bed face diameter, and no feature thinner than 0.8 mm.
The adapter shall be one manifold body.
The adapter shall have no opening other than the two ends of the bore, and no internal cavity.

The design shall be delivered as an STL, the OpenSCAD source, the declared layout and the agent's own measurement report, and that report shall agree with an independent measurement to within 0.10 mm.

beyond_library: a revolved profile with a concentric step: spigot, three ribs, cone transition, socket and shoulder on one axis
dimensions derived from the joined parts' parameters (hose inner diameter, pipe outer diameter) with the fit clearances applied, never typed
a blind socket (bore not through) with a flat shoulder and a through bore beyond it
print-orientation reasoning: which end goes on the bed so that the flat shoulder faces up and the transition is at most 45 degrees
parts catalogue: load part.json generic_tube parameters (OD, ID, length) for the hose and the pipe and read AXIS, BORE, END_START, END_FAR datums
profile checks on a single body: radius versus height sampling, wall thickness by ray casting, overhang scan, coaxiality of sections
interference checks against external solids: clear_of for the pipe in the socket, seat verification at the shoulder
